fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable auto scaling. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否启用自动伸缩，取值：

`true`：开启节点池自动伸缩功能。当集群的容量规划无法满足应用Pod调度时，ACK会根据配置的最小和最大实例数自动扩缩节点资源。1.24及以上版本的集群默认启用节点即时弹性；
1.24以下版本的集群默认启用节点自动伸缩。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2746785.html。

`false`：不开启自动伸缩，ACK会根据配置的期望节点数调整节点池中的节点数，将节点数始终维持在期望节点数。

当取值为false时，`auto_scaling`内的其他配置参数将不生效。

默认值：`false`
fields.name: enable

fields.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated. Use internet_charge_type and internet_max_bandwidth_out instead
fields.help_zh:
【该字段已废弃】该字段已废弃，请使用internet_charge_type和internet_max_bandwidth_out替代。

`true`：绑定EIP。
`false`：不绑定EIP。

默认值：`false`
fields.name: is_bond_eip

fields.help_en: The maximum number of instances that can be scaled out in the node pool, excluding your existing instances. This parameter takes effect only when `enable=true`
fields.help_zh:
节点池中可伸缩的最大实例数，不包含您已有的实例。仅当`enable=true`生效。

取值范围[min_instances, 2000]，默认值为0
fields.name: max_instances

fields.help_en:
The minimum number of scalable instances in the node pool, excluding your existing instances. This parameter takes effect only when `enable=true`.

Valid values: [0, max_instances]. Default value: 0.

If the minimum number of instances is not 0, the scaling group automatically creates the corresponding number of ECS instances after it takes effect.
Set the maximum number of instances to a value that is not less than the current number of nodes in the node pool. Otherwise, nodes in the node pool are scaled in after the auto scaling feature takes effect
fields.help_zh:
节点池中可伸缩的最小实例数，不包含您已有的实例。仅当`enable=true`生效。

取值范围[0, max_instances]，默认值为0。

最小实例数不为0时，伸缩组生效后，将自动创建对应数量的ECS实例。
建议设置的最大实例数不要小于当前节点池中的节点数，否则弹性伸缩功能生效后会直接导致节点池的节点缩容
fields.name: min_instances

fields.help_en: The auto scaling type, classified by instance type. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
自动伸缩类型，按照自动伸缩实例类型划分。取值：

`cpu`：普通实例型。
`gpu`：GPU实例型。
`gpushare`：GPU共享型。
`spot`：抢占式实例型。

默认值：`cpu`

fields.help_zh:
节点CPU管理策略。当集群版本在1.12.6及以上时支持以下两种策略：

`static`：允许为节点上具有某些资源特征Pod增强其CPU亲和性和独占性。
`none`：表示启用现有的默认CPU亲和性方案。

默认值：`none`

fields.help_en: The node labels. You can add labels to the nodes in the Kubernetes cluster. Label definition rules:
fields.help_zh:
节点标签，为Kubernetes集群节点添加标签。标签定义规则：

标签由区分大小写的键值对组成，您最多可以设置20个标签。
标签键不可以重复，最长为64个字符；标签值可以为空，最长为128个字符。标签键和标签值都不能以`aliyun`、`acs:`、`https://`或`http://`开头。更多信息，请参见Labels and Selectors (https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/#syntax-and-character-set)
fields.name: labels

fields.help_en: The custom node name parameter. A node name consists of three parts: prefix + node IP address + suffix
fields.help_zh:
自定义节点名称参数。节点名称由三部分组成：前缀 + 节点 IP + 后缀

前缀和后缀均可由“.”分隔的一个或多个部分构成，每个部分可以使用小写字母、数字和“-”，节点名称首尾必须为小写字母和数字；节点 IP 为完整的节点私网 IP 地址；

传参包含四个部分，由逗号分隔，例如：参数传入"customized,aliyun,ip,com"字符串（其中“customized”和"ip"为固定的字符串，aliyun 为前缀，com 为后缀），则节点的名称为：aliyun.192.168.xxx.xxx.com
fields.name: node_name_mode

fields.help_en: The pre-user data of the instance. Before a node joins the cluster, the specified pre-user data script is run. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49121.html
fields.help_zh: 实例预自定义数据。节点加入集群前，将运行您指定的实例预自定义数据脚本。请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49121.html
fields.name: pre_user_data

fields.help_en:
The container runtime name. ACK supports the following three container runtimes.

containerd: Recommended. Supports all cluster versions.
Sandboxed-Container.runv: Sandboxed container runtime that provides higher isolation. Supports clusters of version 1.31 and earlier.
docker: No longer maintained. Supports clusters of version 1.22 and earlier.

Default value: containerd
fields.help_zh:
容器运行时名称，ACK 支持以下三种容器运行时。

containerd：推荐使用，支持所有集群版本。
Sandboxed-Container.runv：安全沙箱容器，提供更高的隔离性，支持 1.31 及以下版本集群。
docker：已停止维护，支持1.22及以下版本集群。

默认值：containerd
fields.name: runtime

fields.help_en: The container runtime version
fields.help_zh: 容器运行时版本
fields.name: runtime_version

fields.help_en:
The scheduling policy. Valid values:

`NoSchedule`: This taint is not tolerated. However, pods that are already scheduled to the node are not affected.
`NoExecute`: Pods that do not tolerate this taint are evicted after this taint is added to the node.
`PreferNoSchedule`: This value specifies a soft limit on pods. Existing pods on the node are not affected. The scheduler attempts to avoid scheduling pods that cannot tolerate the taint to the node.

Default value: `NoSchedule`
fields.help_zh:
调度策略。取值：

`NoSchedule`：不能容忍，但仅影响调度过程，已被调度的Pod不受影响，仅对新增加的Pod生效。

`NoExecute`：不能容忍，当污点变动时，Pod对象会被驱逐。

`PreferNoSchedule`：柔性约束，节点现存Pod不受影响。尽量不去满足不合要求的Pod调度到节点上。

默认策略：`NoSchedule`
fields.name: effect

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically repair nodes. This parameter takes effect only when `enable=true`.

`true`: Automatically repairs nodes.

`false`: Does not automatically repair nodes.

Default value: `true`
fields.help_zh:
是否自动修复节点，仅当`enable=true`时生效。

`true`：自动修复。

`false`：不自动修复。

默认值为`true`

fields.help_zh: 节点修复是否需要人工审批

fields.help_zh: 自动修复策略ID
fields.name: auto_repair_policy_id

fields.help_en: The maximum number of nodes that can be repaired in parallel. When a large number of abnormal nodes exist in the node pool, this parameter specifies the maximum number or percentage of nodes that can be repaired simultaneously. You can specify a number (such as 5, valid range: 1 to 100000) or a percentage (such as 10%, valid range: 1% to 100%). Default value: 1
fields.help_zh: 最大并行修复数，节点池中存在大量异常节点时，最多允许同时修复的节点数或节点比例。支持数量（如 5，取值范围 1~100000）或百分比（如 10%，取值范围 1%~100%）。后端默认并行修复数：1
fields.name: max_parallel_repairing_nodes

fields.help_en: The circuit breaker condition for self-healing. When the number or percentage of faulty nodes exceeds this threshold, self-healing enters a circuit breaker state and stops initiating new repair actions. You can specify a number (such as 10, valid range: 1 to 100000) or a percentage (such as 20%, valid range: 1% to 100%). Default value: 100%
fields.help_zh: 自愈熔断条件，当发生故障的节点数或节点比例大于该阈值时，自愈进入熔断状态，并停止新增自愈修复动作。支持数量（如 10，取值范围 1~100000）或百分比（如 20%，取值范围 1%~100%）。后端默认熔断条件为：100%
fields.name: max_unhealthy_nodes_threshold

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow node restart. This parameter takes effect only when `auto_repair=true`. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否允许重启节点，仅当`auto_repair=true`时生效。取值：

`true`：允许重启节点。
`false`：不允许重启节点。

fields.help_en: The auto repair node policy
fields.help_zh: 自动修复节点策略

`true`：允许自动升级操作系统。

指定在漏洞修复过程中应排除的包。

`true`：自动续费。
`false`：不自动续费。

默认值：`false`
fields.name: auto_renew

fields.help_en: The duration of a single auto-renewal cycle. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
单次自动续费的续费时长。取值范围：
PeriodUnit=Week 时：1、2、3。
PeriodUnit=Month 时：1、2、3、6、12、24、36、48、60。

默认值：1
fields.name: auto_renew_period

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow the automatic creation of pay-as-you-go instances to meet the required number of ECS instances when spot instances cannot be created due to cost or inventory reasons, if `multi_az_policy` is set to `COST_OPTIMIZED`. Valid values:

`true`: allows the automatic creation of pay-as-you-go instances to meet the required number of ECS instances.
`false`: does not allow the automatic creation of pay-as-you-go instances to meet the required number of ECS instances
fields.help_zh:
当`multi_az_policy`取值为`COST_OPTIMIZED`时，如果因价格、库存等原因无法创建足够的抢占式实例，是否允许自动尝试创建按量实例满足ECS实例数量要求。取值：

`true`：允许自动尝试创建按量实例满足ECS实例数量要求。
`false`：不允许自动尝试创建按量实例满足ECS实例数量要求
fields.name: compensate_with_on_demand

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically mount the data disk
fields.help_zh: 是否挂载
fields.name: auto_format

fields.help_en:
The ID of the automatic snapshot policy. The system performs automatic backup for a cloud disk based on the specified automatic snapshot policy.

By default, this parameter is empty, which indicates that automatic backup is disabled
fields.help_zh:
选择自动快照策略ID，云盘会按照快照策略自动备份。

默认值：空，不自动备份

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the burst feature for the data disk. Valid values:

`true`: enables the burst feature.
`false`: disables the burst feature for the data disk.

fields.help_zh:
数据盘是否开启Burst（性能突发）。
取值：
`true`：是。
`false`：否。

当`DiskCategory`取值为`cloud_auto`时才支持设置该参数。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html
fields.name: bursting_enabled

fields.help_en:
The category of data disk. Valid values:

`cloud`: basic disk.
`cloud_efficiency`: ultra disk
`cloud_ssd`: standard SSD.
`cloud_essd`: Enterprise ESSD (ESSD).
`cloud_auto`: ESSD AutoPL disk.
`cloud_essd_entry`: ESSD Entry disk.
`elastic_ephemeral_disk_premium`: premium elastic ephemeral disk.
`elastic_ephemeral_disk_standard`: standard elastic ephemeral disk.

Default value: `cloud_efficiency`
fields.help_zh:
数据盘类型。取值：

`cloud`：普通云盘。
`cloud_efficiency`：高效云盘。
`cloud_ssd`：SSD云盘。
`cloud_essd`：ESSD云盘。
`cloud_auto`：ESSD AutoPL云盘。
`cloud_essd_entry`：ESSD Entry 云盘。
`elastic_ephemeral_disk_premium`：弹性临时盘高级版。
`elastic_ephemeral_disk_standard`：弹性临时盘标准版。

默认值：`cloud_efficiency`
fields.name: category

fields.help_en: The mount target of the data disk. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically assigns a mount target when you create an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance. Valid values: /dev/xvdb to /dev/xvdz
fields.help_zh: 数据盘的挂载点。如果您没有指定该参数，则默认在自动创建ECS实例时由系统分配，从/dev/xvdb开始，到/dev/xvdz结束
fields.name: device

fields.help_en: The data disk name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with http:// or https://. The name can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
fields.help_zh: 数据盘名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
fields.name: disk_name

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to encrypt the data disk. Valid values:

`true`: encrypts the data disk.
`false`: does not encrypt the data disk.

Default value: `false`
fields.help_zh:
是否对数据盘加密。取值：

`true`：对数据盘加密。
`false`：不对数据盘加密。

默认值：`false`
fields.name: encrypted

fields.help_en: The file system that is mounted. This parameter takes effect only if auto_format is set to true. Valid values: ext4 and xfs
fields.help_zh: 挂载文件系统类型。auto_format为true时生效，可选值：[ext4,xfs]
fields.name: file_system

fields.help_en: The ID of the Key Management Service (KMS) key that is used to encrypt the data disk
fields.help_zh: 数据盘对应的KMS密钥ID
fields.name: kms_key_id

fields.help_en: The path to which the data disk is mounted. You must specify a valid path
fields.help_zh: 挂载路径。需要为合法文件路径
fields.name: mount_target

fields.help_en: The performance level (PL) of the data disk. This parameter takes effect only for an ESSD. This parameter is related to the disk size. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
fields.help_zh: 节点数据盘磁盘性能等级，仅对ESSD磁盘生效。磁盘性能等级和磁盘大小有关。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
fields.name: performance_level

fields.help_en:
The preset IOPS of the data disk. Valid values: 0 to min{50,000, 1,000 × Capacity - Baseline IOPS}. Baseline IOPS = min{1,800 + 50 × Capacity, 50,000}.

This parameter is available only if `DiskCategory` is set to `cloud_auto`. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html
fields.help_zh:
数据盘预配置的读写IOPS。可能值：0~min{50,000, 1000*容量-基准性能}。
基准性能=min{1,800+50*容量, 50000}。

当`DiskCategory`取值为`cloud_auto`时才支持设置该参数。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html
fields.name: provisioned_iops

fields.help_en:
The size of the data disk. Unit: GiB.

Valid values: 40 to 32768.

Default value: `120`
fields.help_zh:
数据盘大小，单位为GiB。

取值范围：[40,32768]。

默认值：`120`
fields.name: size

fields.help_en: The ID of the snapshot that you want to use to create the data disk. If this parameter is specified, the specified size of the data disk is ignored. The size of the disk equals the size of the specified snapshot. If the snapshot was created on or before July 15, 2013, the API request is rejected and the InvalidSnapshot.TooOld message is returned
fields.help_zh: 创建数据盘时使用的快照。指定该参数后，DataDisks.Size会被忽略，实际创建的磁盘大小为指定快照的大小。如果该快照创建于2013年7月15日或之前，调用会被拒绝，返回参数中会提示InvalidSnapshot.TooOld
fields.name: snapshot_id

fields.help_en: The data cloud disk configurations for nodes. Valid values: 0 to 10. You can add up to 10 data cloud disks
fields.help_zh: 节点数据盘配置，取值范围[0,10]。最多支持添加10块数据盘
fields.name: data_disks

fields.help_en: The deployment set to which the ECS instances created by the node pool belong. This setting takes effect only on new nodes. The deployment set of existing nodes is not changed
fields.help_zh: 节点池弹出ECS所属的部署集，仅对增量节点生效，存量节点的部署集不会变更
fields.name: deploymentset_id

fields.help_en: The desired number of nodes in the node pool
fields.help_zh:
节点池期望节点数量。

节点池应该维持的总节点数量，建议至少配置2个节点，以确保集群组件正常运行。您可以通过调整期望节点数，达到扩容或缩容节点池的目的。

如无需创建节点，可填写为0，后续再手动调整，增加节点数
fields.name: desired_size

fields.help_en:
唯一标识该节点池中的一块盘。
当local_disk为false时，必须与scaling_group.data_disks中的某一个disk_name匹配；
当local_disk为true时，必须与scaling_group.data_disks中的任意disk_name不同
fields.help_zh:
唯一标识该节点池中的一块盘。
当local_disk为false时，必须与scaling_group.data_disks中的某一个disk_name匹配；
当local_disk为true时，必须与scaling_group.data_disks中的任意disk_name不同

fields.help_en:
该配置为本地盘的配置。设置为true时
通过ECS DiskName和符号链接匹配不上时，可匹配本地盘，
开机时若检测到未初始化则会重新初始化，

fields.help_zh: 自动格式化文件系统的类型。留空表示不格式化

fields.help_en: 容器运行时数据存储到该盘

fields.name: mount_for_runtime

fields.help_en: 挂载目录，留空则不挂载
fields.help_zh: 挂载目录，留空则不挂载
fields.name: mount_target

fields.help_en: The block device initialization configuration
fields.help_zh: 块设备初始化配置
fields.name: disk_init

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable high-density cloud disk mode. This is supported only when the node pool uses instance types. When enabled, the total number of system cloud disks and data cloud disks does not exceed the high-density cloud disk count supported by the instance type
fields.help_zh: 是否开启高密云盘模式。仅在节点池使用实例规格时支持，开启后系统盘与数据盘之和不超过规格支持的高密云盘数量
fields.name: enable_high_density_mode

fields.help_en: The custom image ID. You can call `DescribeKubernetesVersionMetadata` to query the images supported by the system. The latest system image is used by default
fields.help_zh: 自定义镜像ID。可通过`DescribeKubernetesVersionMetadata`查询系统支持的镜像，默认使用系统最新镜像
fields.name: image_id

fields.help_en:
The operating system distribution type. We recommend that you use this field to specify the node operating system. Valid values:

`AliyunLinux`: Alinux2 image.
`AliyunLinuxSecurity`: Alinux2 UEFI image.
`AliyunLinux3`: Alinux3 image.
`AliyunLinux3Arm64`: Alinux3 ARM image.
`AliyunLinux3Security`: Alinux3 UEFI image.
`CentOS`: CentOS image.
`Windows`: Windows image.
`WindowsCore`: WindowsCore image.
`ContainerOS`: Container-optimized image.
`AliyunLinux3ContainerOptimized`: Alinux3 container-optimized image
fields.help_zh:
操作系统发行版类型，推荐使用该字段指定节点操作系统。取值：

`AliyunLinux`：Alinux2镜像。
`AliyunLinuxSecurity`：Alinux2镜像UEFI版。
`AliyunLinux3`：Alinux3镜像。
`AliyunLinux3Arm64`：Alinux3镜像ARM版。
`AliyunLinux3Security`：Alinux3镜像UEFI版。
`CentOS`：CentOS镜像。
`Windows`：Windows镜像。
`WindowsCore`：WindowsCore镜像。
`ContainerOS`：容器优化镜像。
`AliyunLinux3ContainerOptimized`: Alinux3镜像容器优化版
fields.name: image_type

fields.help_en: The billing method of nodes in the node pool. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
节点池节点付费类型，取值：

`PrePaid`：预付费
`PostPaid`：按量付费

默认值：`PostPaid`
fields.name: instance_charge_type

fields.help_zh: 【该参数已废弃，请勿使用】是否为性能突发实例规格

fields.help_en: [This parameter is deprecated and replaced by cores] The number of vCores provided by the instance type
fields.help_zh: 【该参数已废弃，使用cores参数替代】实例规格的 vCPU 内核数目

fields.help_zh: 实例规格的 vCPU 内核数目

fields.help_zh: 实例的CPU架构

fields.help_zh: 需要排除的实例规格

fields.help_zh: 实例分类

fields.help_zh: 指定实例规格族

fields.help_zh: 实例规格的最大vCPU内核数目

fields.help_en: The maximum allowed memory size. Unit: GiB
fields.help_zh: 实例规格的最大内存。单位：GiB

fields.help_zh: 【该参数已废弃，请勿使用】实例每小时最高价格
fields.name: max_price

fields.help_en: The maximum allowed number of GPUs per instance
fields.help_zh: 期望最大 GPU 数目
fields.name: maximum_gpu_amount

fields.help_en: The memory size of the instance type. Unit: GiB
fields.help_zh: 实例规格的内存大小，单位为 GiB
fields.name: memory

fields.help_en: The minimum vCPU cores required for the instance type
fields.help_zh: 实例规格的最小vCPU内核数目
fields.name: min_cpu_cores

fields.help_en: The minimum required memory size. Unit: GiB
fields.help_zh: 实例规格的最小内存。单位：GiB
fields.name: min_memory_size

fields.help_en: The minimum required number of IPv6 addresses per ENI
fields.help_zh: 期望最小单块弹性网卡的 IPv6 地址数

fields.help_en: The minimum required number of IPv4 addresses per ENI
fields.help_zh: 期望最小单块弹性网卡的 IPv4 地址数
fields.name: minimum_eni_private_ip_address_quantity

fields.help_en: The minimum required number of elastic network interfaces (ENIs) per instance
fields.help_zh: 期望最小支持挂载的弹性网卡数
fields.name: minimum_eni_quantity

fields.help_en: The instance attribute configurations
fields.help_zh: 实例属性配置
fields.name: instance_patterns

fields.help_en: The list of node instance types. You can specify multiple instance types as alternatives. During node creation, the system attempts to purchase instances starting from the first specification until the creation succeeds. The final purchased instance type may vary depending on inventory availability
fields.help_zh:
节点实例规格列表，您可以选择多个实例规格作为备选，每个节点创建时，将从第一个规格开始尝试购买，直到创建成功。最终购买的实例规格可能随库存变化而不同。

支持的实例规格数量范围：[1,10]
fields.name: instance_types

fields.help_en: The billing method for public IP addresses. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
公网IP收费类型。取值：

`PayByBandwidth`：按固定带宽计费。
`PayByTraffic`：按使用流量计费
fields.name: internet_charge_type

fields.help_en: The maximum outbound bandwidth for the node public IP address. Unit: Mbps (Mega bit per second). Valid values: [1,100]
fields.help_zh: 节点公网IP出带宽最大值，单位为Mbps（Mega bit per second），取值范围：[1,100]
fields.name: internet_max_bandwidth_out

fields.help_en: The key pair name. Specify either this parameter or `login_password`. When the node pool is a managed node pool, only `key_pair` is supported
fields.help_zh: 密钥对名称，和`login_password`二选一。当节点池为托管版节点池时，只支持`key_pair`
fields.name: key_pair

fields.help_en: The SSH logon password. Specify either this parameter or `key_pair`. The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length and must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters
fields.help_zh: SSH登录密码，和`key_pair`二选一。密码规则为8~30个字符，且至少同时包含三项（大小写字母、数字和特殊符号）
fields.name: login_password

fields.help_en: The multi-zone scaling policy for ECS instances in the scaling group. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
多可用区伸缩组ECS实例扩缩容策略。取值：

`PRIORITY`：根据您定义的虚拟交换机（VSwitchIds.N）扩缩容。当优先级较高的虚拟交换机所在可用区无法创建ECS实例时，自动使用下一优先级的虚拟交换机创建ECS实例。

`COST_OPTIMIZED`：按vCPU单价从低到高进行尝试创建。当伸缩配置设置了抢占式计费方式的多实例规格时，优先创建对应抢占式实例。您可以继续通过`CompensateWithOnDemand`参数指定当抢占式实例由于库存等原因无法创建时，是否自动尝试以按量付费的方式创建。

`COST_OPTIMIZED`仅在伸缩配置设置了多实例规格或者选用了抢占式实例的情况下生效。

`BALANCE`：在伸缩组指定的多可用区之间均匀分配ECS实例。如果由于库存不足等原因可用区之间变得不平衡，您可以通过API `RebalanceInstances`平衡资源。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/71516.html。

默认值：`PRIORITY`
fields.name: multi_az_policy

fields.help_en: The minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances required by the scaling group. Valid values: [0,1000]. Pay-as-you-go instances are created with priority when the number of pay-as-you-go instances is less than this value
fields.help_zh: 伸缩组所需要按量实例个数的最小值，取值范围：[0,1000]。当按量实例个数少于该值时，将优先创建按量实例
fields.name: on_demand_base_capacity

fields.help_en: The percentage of pay-as-you-go instances among the instances that exceed the minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances (`on_demand_base_capacity`) in the scaling group. Valid values: [0,100]
fields.help_zh: 伸缩组满足最小按量实例数（`on_demand_base_capacity`）要求后，超出的实例中按量实例应占的比例。取值范围：[0,100]
fields.name: on_demand_percentage_above_base_capacity

fields.help_en:
The subscription duration of nodes in the node pool. This parameter takes effect only when `instance_charge_type` is set to `PrePaid` and is required in this case.

When `period_unit=Week`, valid values of `period`: 1, 2, 3, and 4.
When `period_unit=Month`, valid values of `period`: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, 36, 48, and 60
fields.name: period

fields.help_en: The billing cycle of nodes in the node pool. This parameter takes effect and is required only when `instance_charge_type` is set to `PrePaid`
fields.help_zh:
节点池节点付费周期，仅当`instance_charge_type`取值为`PrePaid`时生效，且为必选值。

`Month`：以月为计时单位。
`Week`：以周为计算单位。

默认值：`Month`
fields.name: period_unit

The operating system platform. Valid values:

`AliyunLinux`
`CentOS`
`Windows`
`WindowsCore`
fields.help_zh:
【该字段已废弃】请使用`image_type`参数代替。

操作系统平台。取值：

`AliyunLinux`
`CentOS`
`Windows`
`WindowsCore`
fields.name: platform

fields.help_en: The private node pool ID. When `match_criteria` is set to `Target`, you must specify the private pool ID
fields.help_zh: 私有节点池ID。当`match_criteria`为`Target`时，需要进一步指定私有池ID
fields.name: id

fields.help_en:
The type of the private node pool. The private pool option for instance launch. After an elasticity assurance or capacity reservation takes effect, a private pool is generated for instances to use during launch. Valid values:
`Open`: open mode. The system automatically matches open private pool capacity. If no matching private pool capacity is available, public pool resources are used to launch the instance.
`Target`: targeted mode. The instance is launched using the specified private pool capacity. If the specified private pool capacity is unavailable, the instance fails to launch.
`None`: none mode. The instance launch does not use private pool capacity
fields.help_zh:
私有节点池类型，实例启动的私有池容量选项。弹性保障服务或容量预定服务在生效后会生成私有池容量，供实例启动时选择。取值：
`Open`：开放模式。将自动匹配开放类型的私有池容量。如果没有符合条件的私有池容量，则使用公共池资源启动。
`Target`：指定模式。使用指定的私有池容量启动实例，如果该私有池容量不可用，则实例会启动失败。
`None`：不使用模式。实例启动将不使用私有池容量
fields.name: match_criteria

fields.help_en: The private node pool configuration
fields.help_zh: 私有节点池配置
fields.name: private_pool_options

fields.help_en: The list of RDS instances
fields.help_zh: RDS实例列表
fields.name: rds_instances

fields.help_en: The list of private pool IDs, which are elasticity assurance IDs or capacity reservation IDs. Only Target mode private pool IDs can be specified. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 私有池 ID列表。即弹性保障服务 ID 或容量预定服务 ID。该参数只能传入 Target 模式私有池 ID。N 的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: private_pool_ids

fields.help_en:
The resource pool strategy used when instances are created. Resource pools include private pools generated after elasticity assurance or capacity reservation takes effect, and public pools, which are available for instance startup. Valid values:

PrivatePoolFirst: private pool preferred. When this strategy is selected, if resouce_pool_options.private_pool_ids is specified, the specified private pools are used first. If no private pool is specified or the specified private pool has insufficient capacity, open-type private pools are automatically matched. If no eligible private pool is available, the public pool is used to create instances.
PrivatePoolOnly: private pool only. When this strategy is selected, you must specify resouce_pool_options.private_pool_ids. If the specified private pool has insufficient capacity, the instance fails to start.
None: no resource pool strategy is used.

Default value: None
fields.help_zh:
创建实例时使用的资源池策略。资源池包括弹性保障服务或容量预定服务生效后生成的私有池以及公共池，供实例启动时选择。取值范围：
PrivatePoolFirst：私有池优先。选择此种策略时， 当指定了 resouce_pool_options.private_pool_ids，优先使用指定的私有池。如果未指定私有池或指定的私有池容量不足，将自动匹配开放类型的私有池。如果没有符合条件的私有池，则使用公共池创建实例。
PrivatePoolOnly：仅限私有池。选择此种策略时，必须指定 resouce_pool_options.private_pool_ids。如果指定的私有池容量不足，则实例会启动失败。
None：不使用资源池策略。
默认值：None
